annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, algorithm linkage, exact residual semantics, source constants, and full finite Lemma 4.3 reconstruction

assumptions: The system dimension n is positive, A is nonsingular with a two-sided inverse Ainv, and x is the exact solution of A*x=b.
The iterates, computed residuals, and corrections form the paper's column-pivoted iterative-refinement run, including x_0=0, r_0=-b, d_0=-x_1, and computed x_(m+1)=x_m-d_m.
The residual subtraction is performed last; residual accumulation is single precision with ubar=u or double precision with ubar=u^2 followed by conversion to working precision.
The positive working unit roundoff satisfies n*u<=0.01, every represented operation is a well-defined real result, and the operation and conversion traces satisfy the paper's relative-error model.
Every column-pivoted solve has the source componentwise backward-error certificate with the nonnegative matrix C_1.
The chosen vector norm is absolute, monotone, normalized on basis vectors, and extended to its induced matrix norm; kappa(Ainv)=||abs(A)*abs(Ainv)||.
C_2,C_6,...,C_12 and c_1,c_3,c_4,c_5,c_8 satisfy the exact definitions and nonnegativity properties printed in the Notes on pages 823, 826, and 827.
The exact Lemma 4.1 estimate and forward-error half of Lemma 4.2 are available as prior proved bounds; the page-827 recurrence and Lemma 4.3 conclusion are not assumed.
The final smallness condition is c_8*u*kappa(Ainv)<=1/2; c_1<=c_8 supplies the earlier Lemma 4.1 condition.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p08_t3_lemma_4_3_exact_residual_bound {n : Nat} (run : P08IterativeRefinementRun n) (norm : P08AbsoluteMonotoneNorm n) (constants : P08Lemma43Constants run norm) (prior : P08Lemma43PriorBounds run norm constants) (hsmall : constants.c8 * run.u * p08KappaInverse run norm <= 1/2) : forall m i, abs (p08ExactResidualAfterCorrection run m i) <= p08Lemma43Bound constants m i
formal_statement.plain_language: For every iteration m, the exact residual q_(m+1) of the linked column-pivoted iterative-refinement run satisfies Lemma 4.3's complete four-term componentwise finite bound under the source c_8*u*kappa(A^{-1}) threshold.

informal_proof: Use c_1<=c_8 to discharge Lemma 4.1's smallness condition. Its m=0 instance and x_0=0 give the q_1 base coefficient C_10. For the induction step, substitute Lemma 4.2's bound for |x_(m+1)-x| into Lemma 4.1 at m+1, obtaining the source recurrence with propagation u*C_8*|A|*|Ainv| and forcing terms containing C_9 and C_7. The resolvent identities for C_11 and C_12 make the three stationary terms a fixed supersolution. Componentwise monotonicity of the nonnegative propagation matrix and matrix-power induction then yield exactly the exponent-m four-term bound.
informal_statement: The full algorithm-linked, precision-sensitive, componentwise exact-residual bound of Lemma 4.3, with q_1 as the base case and no artificial q_0.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 35, issue 151, July 1980, printed pages 817-832
